The C1 composition proposal also resolves this at zero cost. Under K_eff = D(w)^(1/2) Sigma^-1 D(w)^(1/2), the coherent normalizer has the closed form

  a^T K_eff^-1 a = (1/W^2) sqrt(w)^T Sigma sqrt(w),   a = w/W, W = sum(w)

verified to 1e-12. This needs Sigma - the shrunk residual covariance the learner already holds BEFORE inversion - and no factorization or solve at all. The O(k^3)-per-support-per-edge concern disappears entirely, provided the metric handle exposes the covariance (or a quadform_Kinv entry point) rather than only apply_K.
